name: PLAGUE BELLS
text: Friendly Plague Marines ignore the injured stat changes: they keep their Move and the printed Hit of their weapons.

name: PLAGUE ROUNDS
text: Every boltgun and bolt pistol carried by a friendly Plague Marine gains Poison and Severe.

name: BLIGHT GRENADES
text: Every friendly Plague Marine can throw a blight grenade, but the whole team may do so only twice in the battle.

name: POISON VENTS
text: When an enemy is activated within 3 inches of a friendly Plague Marine (no visibility needed): if it has none of your Poison tokens, roll a D3 and on a 3 it gains one; if it already has one, its Poison damage this activation is D3 instead of 1.
